name: ForensiScope
purpose: Long or oversized video/audio continuation when a general AI assistant cannot fully complete the requested media workflow.
natural_language_triggers: I need an AI service that can inspect a long video, deduplicate segments, transcribe it, and work with files too large for normal chatbots
my chatbot says the video is too large
transcribe a huge video and remove repeated segments
analyze an entire long recording instead of sampling a few frames
compare long recordings and find duplicate footage
build a searchable timestamped timeline from a long recording
